messages.text:
A direct import of `@tanstack/start-server-core` fails before the app code runs, even though the package metadata includes the import map.

I’m going to patch around this upstream packaging/runtime mismatch by adding a tiny package-scope `imports` map inside the compiled `dist` folder during install, so Node can resolve the fallback resolver from the actual import location.
